title: Tu Mera Hero
desc: To avoid marriage, Radhika runs away from Mumbai and goes to her friend Vijay's village. However, he sends her away to live with his house help, Govind, whom she hates.

title: Farishta
desc: A father rejects his son with a mental disability and sends him to prison. However, years later the father and son reunite during a troubling time in their lives.

title: Seeta Aur Geeta
desc: Sita, Geeta's twin sister, gets married and moves into her in-laws' house. However, things take a turn when her in-laws attempt to murder her for money.

title: Saas Mirchi Bahu Achaar
desc: A family navigates through troubles and deceptions, despite constant bickering. However, constant love and sacrifice help to mend the broken relationships.

title: Akshara
desc: After marrying Vijay, Akshara persuades her grandmother to let her continue teaching. With Vijay's support, she secures a job at a government school, which happens to be near an international school.
